lean.statement: ∀ {g b : ℝ}, 0 ≤ g → 0 ≤ b → 0 < g + b → b / (g + b) ≤ b + (1 - Real.sqrt g) ^ 2 ∧ b + (1 - Real.sqrt g) ^ 2 ≤ b + (1 - g) ^ 2
approved_definition_context: Real.sqrt denotes the nonnegative real square root on nonnegative inputs. Real division uses the usual field operation away from zero and has value zero when its denominator is zero.
